Retry policies

The gateway retries failed upstream calls according to the policy attached to each route. Use retry.max_attempts to cap attempts; values above 10 are rejected.

Policy fields

FieldTypeDefaultDescription
max_attemptsinteger3Total attempts, including the first call
backoffstringexponentialOne of fixed | exponential
retry_onlistStatus codes that trigger a retry
(502, 503, 504)

Example

Attach a policy in TypeScript:

import { route } from '@gateway/sdk'

export default route('/orders', {
  retry: { max_attempts: 5, backoff: 'exponential' },
  // ```fences``` inside code must not break the block
})

Or in the YAML config:

routes:
  - path: /orders
    retry:
      max_attempts: 5

Shell:

curl -s https://gateway.example.com/health | jq '.status'
